# Desensitized session history fixtures

These files feed the read-only session parsers of the Records page. They contain no real credentials, user paths or private conversation content: titles and message text are replaced with neutral placeholders while structural fields, event shapes and token counts keep the observed wire form. Fixtures for the legacy CLIs document Codex (`codex-0.158.jsonl`, `codex-last-usage.jsonl`), Claude Code (`claude-2.1.jsonl`), Grok (`grok-1.0/`), Pi (`pi-0.87-v3.jsonl`) and OpenCode sessions.

The 2026-10 default-off additions contribute:

- `zcode-3.14.4-model-io.jsonl` — the bundled agent's model-io rollout log (session messages with per-turn token counts), desensitized from the real 3.14.4 install; `zcode-3.14.4-task.json` is the matching legacy task snapshot shape. The session list, working directories and billed usage come from the internal `cli/db/db.sqlite` store (`session` + `model_usage`); its desensitized schema is built in-test, and rollout logs now only carry the transcript (they proved incomplete as a usage fact source). Reading the internal db is fail-soft: unreadable stores fall back to rollout/snapshot discovery.
- `kimi-code-0.31.1-wire.jsonl` — one `agents/main/wire.jsonl` stream: `context.append_message` user prompts, `content.part` assistant segments (same `turnId` joins into one message) and `usage.record` per-call token totals with `inputOther`/`output`/`inputCacheRead`/`inputCacheCreation` split buckets. Subagent streams contribute additional usage events with wire-scoped ids (regression: multi-agent streams must not overwrite each other in `history_usage`). Older `state.json` schemas record the working directory as `cwd` instead of `workDir`; both are accepted.
- `dsh-0.2.1-v4.session.jsonl.zstd` — a `sessions/<workspace>/session-<uuid>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` log desensitized from the first real machine sample. The container is a stream of concatenated zstd frames (one per appended JSONL record, standard magic, no container header); row 0 is the `session` header and usage rides on `assistant/message` payloads keyed by turn/step. The committed bytes are generated by the in-test encoder and asserted byte-identical so the frame concatenation stays reproducible.
- `codebuddy-2.161.1-session.jsonl` + `codebuddy-2.161.1-session/subagents/agent-*.jsonl` — a `projects/*.jsonl` session turn and its Explore subagent wire, sanitized from one real local session. Usage is counted from every row carrying `providerData.usage` (assistant messages hold the turn-final call; `function_call` rows hold the tool loop's intermediate calls), with row-id dedup; the wire folds its own all-rows usage into the parent session under agent-scoped event ids while its conversation rows stay out of the transcript. turn-metrics `tokenDelta` is a cross-check only (all-rows sum equals it on the verified sessions), never a usage source.

The 2026-10-07 six-client additions (evidence levels: [src] = official open-source repo, [RE] = third-party reverse-engineered, otherwise official docs or local verified):

- `mimo-code-0.1.15/sessions.json` — sanitized row set of the data-root `mimocode.db` (session/message/part tables), synthetic per the [src] schema at XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-Code (`session.sql.ts`; same column shapes, rewritten ids/titles/counts). Tests rebuild the sqlite database deterministically; per-message token splits follow `session.ts getUsage` (input excludes cache read/write, output excludes reasoning) with `agent_id`/`parent_id` subagent attribution.
- `cline-3.0-session/` — sessions.db sanitized row set plus `sessions/<id>/` directories (`manifest.json`, `messages.json` with per-message `metrics{inputTokens,outputTokens,cacheReadTokens,cacheWriteTokens,cost}` where input excludes cache, compaction and subagent `__` stems), synthetic per the [src] summary of cline/cline@main 2026-10-07. The stale row proves an index entry without an on-disk directory surfaces as a failed source instead of silently disappearing.
- `devin-3000-transcript.json` — sanitized ATIF-v1.7 transcript from the locally verified 3000.11.3 install. Per-agent-step `metrics{prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens}` (plus `extra.cache_creation_input_tokens` on one step) become inclusive-bucket usage events: `prompt_tokens` is the full step context and includes `cached_tokens` (verified against all 8 real local transcripts, where step N+1's cached equals step N's prompt and Σ per session matches `final_metrics` exactly); the module tests cross-assert the per-session sums against `final_metrics`.
- `command-code-1.73-session.jsonl` — a `projects/<slug>/<uuid>.jsonl` session (version 3 header, per-message `usage` four-way split plus `costUsd`, input excluding cache), desensitized from real local sessions; the parser was reconciled against 4 real local 1.73.4 sessions read-only.
- `antigravity-cli-1.3/sessions.json` — sanitized row set hand-built from the documented [RE] schema (codeburn reverse engineering of agy 1.2.x; the local 1.3.1 machine has never produced data, so there is no real sample). Tests rebuild `conversation_summaries.db`, `conversations/<id>.db` (`gen_metadata` protobuf `ModelUsageStats`) and `brain/<id>/transcript_full.jsonl` deterministically; protobuf field drift skips rows and degrades partial instead of guessing.
- `kiro-cli-sessions/` — legacy `sessions/cli/<uuid>.jsonl` plus current `sess_<id>/messages.jsonl` shapes, synthetic per [RE] evidence (agentsview/threadle) with the Windows data root (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\kiro-cli`) resolved against a real local install. None of the three session formats carries token fields, so no usage is emitted.

Session parsing is read-only: the adapters never rewrite native history. Parsing fixtures do not establish live session acceptance for any CLI version.
